title: Feature Request: Days of the week in alarms
body:
Hi all,

Before all, thanks for this project, your work is amazing.

I think it might be interesting that when you set an alarm (high or low) in addition to the hours it is active you can choose which days of the week you want it to work. Our son starts school in September and we would like the school nurse to install xDrip on her phone and only have the alarms go off Monday through Friday from 9am to 3pm.

I think it can be something simple, but interesting in future versions of the app.

Thanks!

comments.body:
@javporris This sounds interesting.  But, how will it address a day of the week that happens to be a holiday?  Your son will not go to school on that day but the nurse will still get the alarms on that day even if this suggestion is implemented.
Also the majority of the users who need the alarms all the time any way will now need to worry about one more setting that could be wrong.

Could you please consult with the user community, on the xDrip facebook support group or the Gitter room, to find out what others with similar needs do?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
